method: Train-only exact phrase trie with smoothed occurrence precision, three regex fallbacks, weighted non-overlapping interval decoding.
limitations: Single small split; normalized duplicates grouped, near duplicates not grouped.
Known-count validation uses gold counts because test supplies counts in sample_submission.
Missing predictions score zero; insufficient candidates are not fabricated into a submission.
Regex confidence values are fixed heuristics, not calibrated; weak data unused.
